Thanks, Ava — welcome.

Short checklist to get your vendor master created on our side:
- Legal entity name (exact as on W-9)
- Federal Tax ID / EIN (W-9)
- Remit address for invoicing (street, city, state, ZIP)
- Bank ACH details OR bank letter for wire (we store bank letters for validation)
- Primary AP contact + email for PO-to-invoice questions
- Preferred remit method (ACH / wire / check)

Jordan, can you take a look for any Redwood-specific PO reference fields we should call out?

If you can return the completed form + W-9 and bank letter, we can provision the vendor record and share the vendor ID and PO instructions.
